ns2:course.label: Introduction to Data Storytelling
ns2:course.description: Storytelling thinking, introducing students to the philosophical, social, and relational dynamics of "story" in information organizations of all sizes. Students are exposed to a range of opportunities to apply storytelling thinking as a tool to identify the audience, design means to communicate with them, and develop dynamic triangle of people sharing stories, engaging in constructive dialogs and reinterpreting etc.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
